steps.en: Install all skills into your agent once
steps.zh: 一次性把全部技能装进你的 agent

steps.en: Describe your real business or content problem to the entry skill
steps.zh: 把真实的生意或内容卡点讲给主入口

steps.en: Reads the conversation, picks one lead skill plus at most two helpers
steps.zh: 读对话，选 1 个主技能，最多再配 2 个辅助

steps.en: Hands you a ready-to-send prompt and explains why those skills
steps.zh: 说明推荐理由，给你一段可直接发送的提示词

steps.en: Send that prompt to the chosen skill
steps.zh: 把提示词发给选中的技能

steps.en: Runs the author's framework and returns one judgment plus next actions
steps.zh: 套作者的框架，交回一份判断和下一步动作

value.en: You get an opinionated diagnosis with a concrete next step instead of generic advice
value.zh: 拿到有立场的诊断和能立刻动手的下一步，而不是泛泛建议

sources: https://github.com/dontbesilent2025/dbskill README 安装 (npx -y skills add dontbesilent2025/dbskill -g --all), 快速开始 (/dbs, /dbs-diagnosis, /dbs-content-value, /dbs-hook) and dbskill 怎样工作 (1 lead + up to 2 helper skills, ready-to-send prompt) — main @ a0e6fa35, 2026-09-28
